name: av_vwap
description:
Volume-weighted average price for one stock from Alpha Vantage (VWAP), intraday only.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: VWAP"} keyed by timestamp, each with VWAP. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min or 60min; when omitted the tool sends 15min, although the schema default says daily, which Alpha Vantage rejects for VWAP); time_period (accepted by the schema but not sent).
Intraday bars: av_stock_intraday; daily trend indicators: av_sma, av_ema.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "15min"}

interval.description: Intraday bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min or 60min (VWAP is intraday only)

time_period.description: Not sent to Alpha Vantage by this tool
